Home.title: Awase
Home.subtitle: An integrated TEI viewer
Home.intro: It brings text, annotations, images, speech analytics, appellation changes, and maps together in a single view.
Home.viewerDescription: Switch between standard reading, LINE-style dialogue, XSL styles, and tag statistics alongside images, variants, appellation changes, speech stats, and maps.
Home.compareDescription: Put two sources or witnesses next to each other and compare character diffs.
Home.xslDescription: Switch between reading view, LINE-style dialogue, facsimile edition, footnotes, and tag statistics.
Home.dtsDescription: Browse and open texts from Distributed Text Services (DTS) catalogs.
Home.useCasesLead: Examples of Awase with real TEI collections. Click a card to open the material directly in Awase.

UseCases.title: Use cases
UseCases.lead: Examples of Awase with real TEI collections. Watch the video, then open the same material with “Open in Awase”.

Compare.title: Compare
Compare.lead: Place the images of two sources side by side and see the differences in their text, character by character. Enter two IIIF manifest URLs.
Compare.sampleKoui: Koui Genji Monogatari and a manuscript from the National Diet Library (Kiritsubo)
Compare.errorFetch: Could not load the manifest. Check the URL and that it allows access from other sites.
Compare.errorNotManifest: This could not be read as an IIIF manifest.
Compare.networkNote: The edit-distance network graph (mode=2) is not built yet. Showing the text diff instead.

Dts.title: Catalog (DTS)
Dts.lead: Browse DTS (Distributed Text Services) collections and open a chosen text in the viewer.
Dts.exampleKouiDesc: Collated text of all 54 chapters of The Tale of Genji with page & line citation units
Dts.exampleDracorDesc: Programmable corpora of European drama in multiple languages
Dts.exampleAlpheiosDesc: A collection of Latin and Greek texts aligned with linguistic annotations (MyCapytain / Nautilus)
Dts.examplePerseidsDesc: Textual resources from Perseus within the Ancient Greek, Latin, Hebrew, and Farsi corpora
Dts.exampleEdhDesc: A corpus of 80,000 short texts from the Latin epigraphic databases

Xsl.sampleTakara: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke, The Three Treasures (Aozora TEI — LINE dialogue & vertical)
Xsl.sampleMeros: Dazai Osamu, Run, Melos! (Aozora TEI — LINE dialogue & entities)
Xsl.sampleYume: Nakahara Chūya, Dream (Aozora TEI — verse & LINE dialogue)
Xsl.sampleReadingSupport: Nagano Prefectural News Vol. 1 (Reading support — Wikipedia cards & curve links)
Xsl.sampleVideoSupport: Nagano Prefectural News Vol. 1 (Video support — synchronized video, captions & terms)

Viewer.title: Viewer
Viewer.lead: Enter the URL of a TEI file to read its text. You can switch between vertical and horizontal writing, and read several texts side by side. When the texts are linked with @corresp, clicking a passage in one highlights the matching passage in the other.
Viewer.sampleYosano: Yosano Akiko's translation of Genji, Kiritsubo (horizontal)
Viewer.sampleParallel: Kōi Genji and Yosano's translation side by side (Kiritsubo)
Viewer.sampleLinked: Eiri Genji and Yosano's translation, linked passage by passage (Kiritsubo, a PTV config.json)
Viewer.sampleAnnan: Tokugawa Ieyasu's Reply to Annam (1601 — 3-layer text, facsimile, map, entities & timeline)
Viewer.sampleTakara: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke, The Three Treasures (Aozora TEI — drama & speech)
Viewer.sampleTakaraLine: Akutagawa Ryūnosuke, The Three Treasures (LINE dialogue view & speech stats)
Viewer.sampleMeros: Dazai Osamu, Run, Melos! (Aozora TEI — appellation changes & speech stats)
Viewer.sampleMerosLine: Dazai Osamu, Run, Melos! (LINE dialogue view, appellation changes & speech stats)
Viewer.sampleReadingSupport: Nagano Prefectural News Vol. 1 (Reading support — Wikipedia cards & curve links)
Viewer.sampleVideoSupport: Nagano Prefectural News Vol. 1 (Video support — synchronized video, captions & terms)
Viewer.sampleGuide: Introduction to TEI/XML encoding (Tag statistics & structure view)
Viewer.witnessDistanceNote: Bars show how far each witness differs from the lemma (sum of edit distances). Click one to read the text as that witness
Viewer.silentWitness: not named; assumed to read as the lemma
